max_fee_cap.meaning: DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP, the maximum dynamic fee cap, reported as 500,000 (50%)

factory_fee_reject_threshold.meaning: CLFactory.getSwapFee() rejection threshold, reported as 100,000 (10%); fees above this are rejected

dynamic_fee_value.meaning: dynamically calculated swap fee value produced by DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()

fee_accepted.meaning: whether CLFactory.getSwapFee() accepts the dynamically calculated fee rather than rejecting it

fallback_to_basic_tick_spacing_fees.meaning: whether the system falls back to basic tick spacing fees

assumptions: The dynamic fee value is expressed in the same fee_units_1e6 scale as MAX_FEE_CAP and the factory rejection threshold, as the report's percentage wording implies.
The fallback to basic tick spacing fees is a downstream consequence of the factory rejecting the dynamic fee; it is not itself a precondition.

unresolved.description: The frozen precondition dynamic_fee_above_10pct states the dynamic fee exceeds 100,000, while the intent requires a fee within MAX_FEE_CAP (500,000) to be accepted; the report does not state a concrete dynamic fee value in the accepted range, so the accepted-scenario witness is symbolic only.
Report does not specify the exact default basic tick spacing fee value used in the fallback, so the fallback outcome is represented only as a Boolean occurrence.

limitations: The selected impact is a downstream fallback consequence; the direct violation is the factory rejecting a fee that is within MAX_FEE_CAP, encoded as fee_accepted being false under the accepted-range condition.
The report does not state who triggers fee evaluation or any caller restriction, so no caller qualifier is encoded.
The dynamic fee value is symbolic; no concrete numeric value above 100,000 is established by the report.
